utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help, but I need to know how long you want me there at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be great, Mina. If you can stay from 10 a.m. to about noon, we should have enough time to get everything set up and help the first neighbors as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, Vik. Can you come for an hour or two on Saturday and help sort things on the porch?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I can do an hour or two on Saturday and help sort things on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I could really use the help this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Uli, thank you. I’ll count on you this Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll let you know what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren, I’d appreciate that. Could you help for part of Saturday on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time do you need me on the front porch Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you come by around 9? I want to get the tables set up before folks start arriving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. Do you still need another helper?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I still need a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Sam, I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch and could use a few helpers. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help at the front porch this Saturday. Just let me know what you need me to do.
